question: How wide is the class in which a value LegalEase writes lands in a blank whose printed caption names a different fact?
nothingWasRepaired: This lane edited no builder, field map, semantics record, packet, receipt, ledger, queue or graph, ran no regeneration, and claimed no family. Every number below is computed, not inferred.

howEachNumberWasObtained.writeSide: every production-field-map.json under data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/*/*/ , read through all six committed schema shapes (maps[].canonicalWrites, documents[].fields[].decision in {write,candidate_write}, documents[].writableAnchors, top-level writes[]), de-duplicated across the canonical and boundary fixtures
howEachNumberWasObtained.captionSide: the SHARED capture, scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs captureWidgetContext, run first-hand over each bound official source binary; the winning caption run was then located independently and tested geometrically against every other widget rectangle on the same page
howEachNumberWasObtained.bindingSide: the SHARED binder, scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs decideBinding, run twice per widget - once with the captured caption and once with the field name alone - so that a write the caption decided is distinguishable from a write the name decided
howEachNumberWasObtained.swornSide: pdftotext -layout over the pinned source binary, per page, matched against sworn/perjury/affidavit/notary/verification language; the matched phrase is recorded beside each finding

coverage.whyTheSchemaListMatters: a probe written against maps[].canonicalWrites alone reads 2,174 of the 3,850 write rows and silently misses 66 families, including every California and Illinois family. The first pass of this measurement did exactly that; the count above is the corrected one.

answerToTheRootCauseQuestion.verdict: SHARED. The defect is in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs and recurs on any form whose geometry matches; it is not particular to AOC-CR-288.
answerToTheRootCauseQuestion.mechanism: captureWidgetContext chooses a caption by geometry alone and never asks whether the run it chose is another blank's label. Two of its rules can take a neighbour's caption: the same-line rule printed_to_the_left_in_the_same_cell takes the previous column's label whenever a form prints its column captions inside the top of the boxes, and the printed_directly_above_in_the_same_column rule takes the caption printed UNDER the rule above whenever a form captions its blanks beneath the line.
answerToTheRootCauseQuestion.whyACaptionBecomesAWrite: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs decideBinding sets subject = effectiveLabel ?? name and, when the field NAME matches no descriptor, falls back to the printed label. A drifted caption then decides the write with factBasis printed_label.
answerToTheRootCauseQuestion.aSecondSharedDefectCoFiresOnAOC-CR-288: the PROTECT_RULES government_identifier pattern matches ssn, social security, soc sec and the driver-licence spellings. AOC-CR-288 names its Full Social Security No. blank SNN, which none of those match, so identifier protection never fired on the name channel and the drifted caption was left to decide. The same name-channel miss repeats on WV SCA-C906 (PetSocSecno) and IN CCA-XP-0220-7009 (AliasNamesDOBsandSSNs).

A_captionCaptureDrift.definition: the run the shared capture chose as a widget's caption is, by its own drawn coordinates, printed inside or directly beneath a DIFFERENT widget's rectangle, so it is that blank's label and not this one's
A_captionCaptureDrift.everyOneOfThe74WasCheckedAgainstTheFamil: in all 74 the family's committed field map names the blank correctly, or the blank's own AcroForm name does, and the value written matches that. The drifted caption did not decide any of these writes.

A_captionCaptureDrift.whyThisStillMatters: a caption is the disclosure label. Where a committed record carries another blank's caption, every downstream artifact that quotes it - a blank disclosure, an approval request, a QA sheet, a reviewer's raster check - describes the wrong blank. It is a verification defect rather than an ink defect, and it is invisible to the nine completeness counters.

theClosestThingToASwornMisWrite.whyItIsNotOne: in each of the seven, the blank's own AcroForm name names the right fact and the value written matches it. What is wrong is the caption the committed record carries for that blank, not the ink.

cases.form: ND petition and order to close nonconviction records
cases.swornMarker: I declare, under penalty of perjury under the law of North Dakota...
cases.note: a proven family, a perjury declaration, and a committed record that describes two blanks as the blanks above them. This is the single most important row in this census and the reason it is not a mis-write is worth stating plainly: the AcroForm names Address and Telephone Number, and that is what each received.

B_semanticMisWrite.definition: a value with semantic role X is WRITTEN into a blank whose printed caption names role Y
howThatZeroWasProved: every one of the 3,825 committed write slots was compared, value role against the blank's own recorded caption and against the blank's own field name, over a 24-role lexicon; 73 candidates surfaced and every one was read individually and resolved as a lexicon artefact or a correct write

the shared binder was re-run over the 309 readable source binaries with no refusals supplied, producing 1,844 would-be writes, of which 301 are decided by the caption and 50 of those by a caption belonging to a different blank; each of the 50 was then joined to every built family that binds that binary
the join outcome: 0 written with the conflicting fact, 48 refused by name in the family's own map, 24 written with a different and correct fact, 4 not present in that family's map at all

theTwoSeedCases.case: TX Statement of Inability to Afford Payment of Court Costs
theTwoSeedCases.note: the eight are field-NAME mis-binds, not caption drift: the shared descriptor list matches Name NombreRowN as a person's name, Direccion Postal as a postal code, County state as a state, and only Month / Mes is decided by a neighbouring caption. Repairing the capture would not have prevented seven of the eight.
theTwoSeedCases.forwardRisk: tx_nd_veterans_court-set and tx_nd_veterans_reemployment-set enclose the same binary and are not built. Neither has an overlay directory under census-v1, so nothing is written today and nothing is measurable; whoever builds them must declare the eight unwritable.

B_semanticMisWrite.theMostImportantFinding: No COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN family carries a sworn mis-write. Seven write slots in proven families are role-conflicting, sit on a page executed under a sworn declaration or before a notary, and sit on a blank whose captured caption belongs to a different blank - two on ND's petition to close nonconviction records page 4 under a penalty-of-perjury declaration, two on AL C-94A page 2 before a notary, three on CT JD-CR-202 page 1 before a notary. In all seven the value written is the right one for that blank, proved from the blank's own AcroForm name. There is no proven family carrying a sworn mis-write to report.
